prompt.description: Text prompt used to AI-generate the mockup image. Required unless `image_url` or `image_file` is provided.
prompt.title: Prompt

image_url.description: URL of an existing image to use as the mockup image. Required unless `prompt` or `image_file` is provided.
image_url.title: Image Url

enhance_prompt.description: Whether to run prompt enhancement before generation. Only applies to the `prompt` flow.
enhance_prompt.title: Enhance Prompt

product.description: Optional product context used to ground the AI generation.

model.description: AI model used for generation. Only applies to the `prompt` flow. Required when `style` is provided. When omitted, generations default to `nano_banana_2`, which runs on Nano Banana 2.1 (Google's `gemini-nano-banana-2.1`) since October 2026. `nano_banana_lite` and `gpt_image_2` apply to product-backed generations (a `product.uuid` present).
model.title: Model

style.description: Visual style applied to the AI generation (e.g. `polaroid-etsy`, `ugc`, `fashion`). Use `GET /mock-anything/styles?model={model}` to list the styles available for a given model; not every model supports every style. When `style` is provided, `model` is required.
style.title: Style

name.description: Optional mockup name shown in the dashboard and returned in the `mockup.name` field.
name.title: Name

collections.description: Optional collections to attach the mockup to. Each item is either an existing collection (by `uuid`) or a new collection to create (by `name`). Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be provided per item.
collections.title: Collections

catalog_uuid.description: Optional UUID of the catalog the mockup belongs to. Defaults to the workspace's default catalog.
catalog_uuid.title: Catalog Uuid

name.description: Name of a new collection to create and attach.
name.title: Name

uuid.description: UUID of a POD product (obtained via `GET /mock-anything/products`) to anchor the AI generation around a specific product type.
uuid.title: Uuid

selected_size.description: Optional product size. Must exactly match one of the product's `sizes[].label` values (from `GET /mock-anything/products/{uuid}`). A matched size is taken into account by the generation where the product's category and size data support it (real-world scale and/or output aspect). A value that matches none of the product's sizes is rejected with a 400 error naming the product's valid size labels; when the product cannot be resolved, the value is accepted without effect. Only meaningful together with `product.uuid`.
selected_size.title: Selected Size

color_name.description: Optional exact product color name from `GET /mock-anything/products/{uuid}`. The value is case-sensitive and must match one of `colors[].name`. Product detail must be available to validate this selector.
color_name.title: Color Name

decorations.description: Optional list of decoration areas to place on the product. Each item can target a canonical `location` or an exact `position_id`, and can select an exact enabled `source`, all from `GET /mock-anything/products/{uuid}`. When omitted, the product's default decoration area and source are used.
decorations.title: Decorations

location.description: Decoration area to target, from `GET /mock-anything/products/{uuid}`. When omitted, the product's default decoration area is used.
location.title: Location

position_id.description: Exact stored decoration position identifier from `decorations[].position_id` in the product detail response. Use this to distinguish provider-specific positions that share a canonical location.
position_id.title: Position Id

source.description: Enabled provider source from the selected product-detail decoration's `sources` list. Matching trims surrounding whitespace and is case-insensitive; the canonical stored source is forwarded. When omitted, the position's default source is used.
source.title: Source

decoration_method.description: Decoration method to apply (e.g. `dtg`, `screen_print`, `embroidery`, `dtf`, `heat_transfer`). The value is forwarded as sent. When the selected position lists methods and none of them matches (case-insensitive; each run of spaces and/or hyphens reads as one `_`; common synonyms such as `screen_printing` = `screen_print` accepted), the request still proceeds and the response carries a `decoration_method_not_supported` warning for that `location`; the source and sizing are not changed. No warning is given for a disabled position or one whose data lists no methods. See product details for valid positions.
decoration_method.title: Decoration Method

Every method except universal simulates a physical print or engraving process and intentionally alters the artwork's colors (ink absorption, desaturation, fabric show-through), most visibly on dark garments. To reproduce your artwork's original colors, set method to universal or omit this field (omitting keeps the template's default finish, which is universal unless the template was saved with a different one); scene lighting and shading still apply.

method.description: The decoration method to apply. universal = flat print that leaves artwork colors unchanged (your chosen blending_mode still applies); screen_print, dtg and uv_print are print finishes that simulate how ink sits on the material and shift artwork colors accordingly (dtg simulates ink soaked into fabric: expect desaturation and strong darkening on dark garments); laser_engrave_surface and laser_engrave_deep are engravings (the artwork acts as a stencil and its colors are replaced by the engraved material); deboss is a pressed-in impression.
method.title: Method

options.description: Optional fine-tuning for the selected method. Only laser_engrave_surface, laser_engrave_deep and deboss read options; any value you omit uses a sensible default.
